$comment: P1↔P2 secure contract parity (data-encryption plan r4 + private-plan §L layout, revised once by L0 2026-10-24: vault objects carry mnt/lease instead of link; legacy entries (§L.3) parse with layout:"legacy" and the OLD derivations — the only sanctioned non-append fixture change; extend cases here only). Shared by tests/secure/config-parity.test.ts (src/secure/config.ts, env.ts) and the launcher tests (src/secure/bin/helper.mjs). Never import across; the two implementations stay separate. settings.expect is the full JSON of parseSecureConfig (present/enabled/valid/vaults/invalid[{name,reason}]/error?); vaults and invalid are sorted by name. settings.probe (optional) lists paths the injected legacy-layout disk probe reports as existing directories (the real default probe lstat's <dir>/mnt). mountinfo realMnt/realCipher are already realpath'd. hubSafeEnv.expect is the full output env; identity=true additionally requires the same object back. N1 (private-plan r3) appended: settings cases for `private` (only true surfaces; non-boolean ⇒ reason private; legacy entries never carry it), a hubSafeEnv case for PI_SECURE_NS, and the new privateRecord section (text ⇒ parsePrivateRecord result, run against config.ts and helper.mjs).
